title: IED Kills Two IDF Reservists in Majdal Zoun
detail: Two Israeli reserve soldiers, Maj. (res.) Harel Birenstock and Sgt. Maj. (res.) Tamir Vaknin of the 55th Paratroopers Brigade, were killed and four others seriously wounded when an explosive device detonated inside a booby-trapped building in Majdal Zoun, a village with no known Hezbollah presence, during an operation to demolish Hezbollah infrastructure. Investigators could not immediately determine when the device was planted or how it detonated.

media.caption: Israeli soldiers killed in an IED blast in Majdal Zoun, south Lebanon

title: Israeli Strike Hits Prayer Hall in Tebnine Cemetery
detail: In response to the Majdal Zoun IED attack, the IDF announced "precise strikes" across southern Lebanon, alleging a blatant ceasefire violation by Hezbollah. One of the strikes hit the roof of a prayer hall in a cemetery in the town of Tebnine, killing one person and wounding twelve others. The strikes occurred as Lebanese and Israeli delegations continued the seventh round of talks in Rome.
